Contributors: Sanborn, D. A. (Daniel Alfred), -1883, cartographer
Forms part of the Sanborn Fire Insurance Map Collection in the Geography and Map Division of the Library of Congress.
In manuscript ink on index plate: "Filed Feb. 4, 1868" and "February 1868, no. 856."
Publication statement: New York : D.A. Sanborn, 1867.
This is the earliest published Sanborn fire insurance map.

This is the earliest published Sanborn fire insurance map. Orientation varies. Includes index. In manuscript ink on index plate: "Filed Feb. 4, 1868" and "February 1868, no. 856." Index tabs removed. Maps mounted on cloth. Phillips, 14416 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Forms part of the Sanborn Fire Insurance Map Collection in the Geography and Map Division of the Library of Congress. Conserved; 002504 1978 Library of Congress Conservation Division. For treatment information, contact the Preservation Directorate. https://ask.loc.gov/preservation pda
